summary: Baileys fork; weak static keyword co-occurrence only
details: Package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library. Static keyword co-occurrence (the words 'ping' and 'GET') matched in lib/Utils/generics.js, which is consistent with the upstream library's normal WhatsApp protocol utilities (websocket keepalive/ping frames and HTTP GET helpers), not with command-execution exfiltration. No traced code path reads installer secrets (environment variables, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles) or ships them to an attacker-controlled destination. No install-time or import-time network fetch-and-execute, no lifecycle script hooks harvesting installer data, no hardcoded non-first-party C2 endpoint identified in the flagged file.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
